items.title: Five equivalent characterizations of geometric regularity for a locally Noetherian scheme over a field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a locally Noetherian scheme X over a field k, the lemma collects five equivalent conditions: geometric regularity of X, regularity after every finitely generated field extension, regularity after every finite purely inseparable extension, geometric regularity of the coordinate ring of every affine open, and the same for the members of one affine open covering (statement lines 2423-2440). The cycle of implications is proved explicitly: geometric regularity makes the local rings of every finitely generated base change regular, which by the criterion for regular schemes makes the base change a regular scheme; the chain down to finite purely inseparable extensions is immediate; the passage from that condition to the algebra statement translates regularity of the base changed affine opens into regularity of the tensor products against finite purely inseparable extensions; and the last step back to geometric regularity glues the base change from the spectra of the tensor products of the coordinate rings of one affine covering (proof lines 2443-2467). The claim is H2: five conditions but a short cycle, with only the local-to-global translations needing care, and the last condition being the pleasant observation that one affine covering suffices.
